summary: Iteration 13 full-stack test of teacher & student portal additions: homeroom 'My Class' (roster, attendance %, achievements CRUD, report-card popup, empty state), homeroom access grants (achievements 403, report-card scoping, class-teacher-only attendance access), Teacher Marks Entry (list/read-only published/editable draft, publish forbidden), student portal My Subjects + Attendance History, plus admin regressions. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py (25 tests, all pass) and re-ran test_iteration12.py: 68/68 pass serially. All test data created was cleaned up and seeded data restored (section A class_teacher_id restored, Grade 6 A Mon P1 timetable room 'Room 204' restored).

minor.issue: No cascade/orphan handling: deleting a teacher assignment or section leaves timetable_entries (teacher_assignment_id), assessments, marks and attendance sheets pointing at a non-existent parent. Subsequent PUT on such a timetable entry fails with 400 'Teacher assignment not found'.

Merge semantics allow an empty room string to silently blank a previously set room; the seeded Grade 6 A Mon P1 entry had lost room 'Room 204' before this run, which failed 3 test_iteration12 assertions. Restored manually — check the admin timetable edit dialog always sends the existing room.

ui_bugs.issue: awarded_by (teacher name) is returned by POST/GET but never rendered in the achievements list — teachers can't see who awarded an achievement
Delete achievement is a single click with no confirmation dialog (destructive, irreversible)

design_issues.screen: Teacher Attendance page + My Class 'Add achievement' dialog
issues: Uses native browser date picker (<input type="date">) instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker used elsewhere — inconsistent look and native OS UI

action_items: Render achievement.awarded_by in the teacher My Class achievements list (and consider showing it on the student portal card)
Add a confirm step for teacher achievement deletion
Ensure the admin timetable entry edit dialog preserves 'room' (an empty submit blanks seeded data); consider ignoring empty-string fields on PUT
Consider cascade/orphan cleanup or validation when teacher assignments/sections are deleted (timetable entries keep dangling teacher_assignment_id)
Replace native date inputs on the teacher attendance page and achievement dialog with the shadcn date picker
server.py is 2002 lines — split into routers (teacher, portal, timetable, marks) per code-review guidance
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_class_access fallbacks verified correct: subject assignment (exact section), blank-section whole-class assignment, and class-teacher-of-section grant (tested by temporarily deleting Meera's Grade 6/A assignment — attendance sheet still 200; assignment restored).

_ensure_homeroom_student correctly returns 403 for non-homeroom students and 400 for unknown students; teacher report-card scoping returns 403 for unrelated classes and 200 for homeroom/assigned classes.
POST /api/assessments/{id}/marks correctly rejects published assessments (400) and out-of-range scores (400); /publish stays 403 for teachers.
GET /api/portal/me returns subjects[] (teacher_name resolved) and attendance_history[] sorted desc and capped at 30; all responses exclude MongoDB _id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest serially: `pytest tests/test_iteration12.py tests/test_iteration13.py -n 0` (68 tests). test_iteration13.py temporarily deletes and re-creates Meera's Grade 6/A Mathematics assignment (new UUID each run) — timetable entries reference teacher_assignment_id, so if a run aborts mid-test the Grade 6 A Mon P1 entry can be orphaned; re-point it or recreate. It also writes an attendance sheet for 2026-07-03 — run `python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter13.py` afterwards (also purges TEST_ artifacts and the portal user). Verified UI: /teacher/my-class (header, roster, print popup, achievement add/delete, empty state), /teacher/marks (+ read-only published, editable draft, no publish buttons), /portal (subjects + attendance chips), admin /app/assessments marks page (Publish/Unpublish present), /app/class-hub/{id} report card popup.
rca_of_the_issue: The 3 initial test_iteration12 failures were data drift, not a code regression: the seeded Grade 6 A Mon P1 timetable entry's room had been blanked (PUT merges payload, so an empty room string overwrites the stored value). After restoring room='Room 204' via the admin API, test_iteration12 is 43/43 again.
